title: Nevermind
studio_context: Sound City, Van Nuys, 2-28 May 1991, on a rented Tama Granstar with a Ludwig Black Beauty and a Tama Bell Brass snare from Drum Doctors; two U87 room mics 15-18 feet back; mixed by Andy Wallace, who used kick and snare samples to drive the reverbs. Polly keeps Chad Channing's cymbals from the 1990 Smart Studios demo.

drum_performances.name: Dave Grohl
drum_performances.why_it_matters: His first record with Nirvana and the drum sound of the decade: 'disco drumming and funk drumming' under the loudest guitars, kept 'as simple as possible'. Teen Spirit's flams and chorus, Lithium's ride and cross-stick, In Bloom, Breed and Territorial Pissings at punk speed.

notable_moments.description: Smells Like Teen Spirit: the chorus on the beat's first sixteenth, two crashes on 1, the snare on 2, its 'a' and the 'e' of 3; 'the "Teen Spirit" beat. That's Dave Grohl's beat' (Nick Oliveri).
Smells Like Teen Spirit: sixteenths on the snare into the chorus with the kick keeping eighths under them.
